LanguageData.IDL_Settings_LootAmountTooltip: Higher values produce more loot rolls and therefore more profit. Lower values produce fewer rolls and less profit. Values below 1x use a proportional chance for a roll to produce no loot.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_ItemAmountTooltip: Higher values increase the number of items produced by each successful loot roll. Lower values reduce the item count and expected profit.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_SearchDurationTooltip: Higher values make dungeon searches take longer. Lower values shorten searches and increase the potential profit per unit of time.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_InfestationsEnabledTooltip: Allows dungeon entrances to trigger RimWorld's deep-drill infestation event. This is enabled by default. Disabling it prevents dungeon entrances from causing insect infestations.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_InfestationChanceTooltip: Scales the existing RimWorld infestation chance for dungeon entrances. 100% preserves the original chance, 50% halves it, and 0% prevents dungeon entrances from causing infestations. This is not a guaranteed chance per scavenging job.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_DungeonThreatsEnabledToolti: Allows completed dungeon jobs to trigger raider or entity encounters. Infestations retain their separate chance but share the same cooldown.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_RaiderThreatsEnabledTooltip: Allows completed dungeon jobs to attract a hostile raid scaled by the storyteller's current threat points.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_EntityThreatsEnabledTooltip: Allows an Anomaly encounter containing only shamblers, only ghouls, or a random mixture of both.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_DungeonThreatChanceTooltip: Chance that a completed dungeon job triggers a raid or entity encounter when the shared cooldown is ready.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_DungeonThreatStrengthToolti: Multiplies the storyteller threat points used to determine raider and entity group sizes.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_DungeonThreatCooldownToolti: Minimum number of in-game days after an infestation, entity encounter, or raid before any of these dungeon threats can occur again.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_AllowDuplicates: Allow duplicate items in one loot result
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_AllowDuplicatesTooltip: When enabled, the same item type can be selected more than once during a single loot result. Disable this for more varied loot.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_CategoryTooltip: Higher values increase loot and expected profit for this category. Lower values reduce both. Setting this to 0x disables loot from the category.
LanguageData.IDL_Threat_RaidersLetterText_1: Raiders have learned of your dungeon and the treasures recovered from its depths. Hoping for easy riches, they are approaching your colony. Prepare for an attack!
LanguageData.IDL_Threat_RaidersLetterText_2: Your expeditions have not gone unnoticed. Armed scavengers followed the trail of recovered treasure back to your colony and now intend to take the dungeon's riches for themselves.
LanguageData.IDL_Threat_RaidersLetterText_3: Rumors of an entrance to untouched underground vaults have spread beyond the colony. A band of raiders has come to seize the dungeon and everything brought out of it.
LanguageData.IDL_Threat_InfestationLetterText_1: The expedition disturbed something deep beneath the dungeon. The ground is splitting open as enraged insects tunnel toward the surface.
LanguageData.IDL_Threat_InfestationLetterText_2: Vibrations from the dungeon have reached a nest hidden far below. Chittering echoes rise through the tunnels, growing louder by the second.
LanguageData.IDL_Threat_InfestationLetterText_3: An ancient passage has collapsed into an insect hive. The brood is awake, furious, and clawing its way toward the dungeon entrance.
LanguageData.IDL_Threat_EntitiesLetterText_1: The expedition has disturbed {0} shamblers and {1} ghouls. They have emerged near the dungeon entrance and are attacking the colony!
LanguageData.IDL_Threat_EntitiesLetterText_2: Dragging footsteps and feral growls echo from below. {0} shamblers and {1} ghouls spill out of the dungeon, driven by mindless hunger.
LanguageData.IDL_Threat_EntitiesLetterText_3: A sealed burial chamber has been breached. Deadlife stirs in the darkness as {0} shamblers and {1} ghouls force their way toward the surface.
